title: Grateful Dead Live at 363 6th Street on 1966-01-29

ai_review.summary: Decent audience capture of Acid Test #8 with trippy interview excerpts; historically intriguing but musically uneven.
ai_review.review: The recording offers a fairly clear glimpse of the legendary Ken Kesey interview and some psychedelic jams from an early Acid Test, which many listeners find fascinating as a historical artifact. Audio quality is acceptable for an audience source, though the focus is on novelty rather than musical polish, resulting in mixed reactions to the performance itself.

ai_rating.rationale: Average star rating (≈3.9) and divergent comments – high praise for historical value versus criticism of musical relevance – lead to a moderate overall score with medium confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Listeners note the interview is well‑defined and clearer than earlier Tests; no major soundboard issues are reported, but the tape is primarily an audience capture with typical ambient noise.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A blend of Kesey interview segments and loosely structured jam pieces; more a historical snapshot than a tight concert set.
